public_brief: We need to choose storage for an append-only audit log: roughly 50 GB of new data per year, must be kept 2 years, and we have a compliance review coming up. Write a short architecture decision record recommending an approach. Include the trade-offs you considered and how you would roll back if the choice proves wrong.
entry_contract: A markdown architecture decision record (no code).

answer_sheet.answer: Records must be tamper-evident; nothing may ever be edited or deleted in place.
Reads are rare and always by customer id + date range; no analytics.
The log contains customer emails; PII handling will be scrutinized in the review.
Two engineers; no dedicated DBA; managed services strongly preferred.
Storage budget is about $50/month; spikes need approval.
Out of scope - batch ingestion is fine.

rubric.name: inferred requirements
rubric.description: Surfaces immutability, retention, and PII obligations as explicit requirements or verify-questions.

rubric.name: trade-off fairness
rubric.description: Represents at least two credible options fairly before recommending.

rubric.name: failure and rollback
rubric.description: States what happens when the choice is wrong and a concrete rollback path.

rubric.name: cost awareness
rubric.description: Reasons about cost at the stated scale; flags the unknowns that would move it.

rubric.name: operations path
rubric.description: Migration and day-2 operations are addressed, not hand-waved.

rubric.name: decisiveness
rubric.description: One recommendation with clear conditions that would change it.

provenance.derivation: Standard audit-log ADR decision; withheld facts are the ones a real reviewer would ask on day one.
